items.title: All smiles in Strasbourg but uncertainty clouds Canada’s EU membership plan

sentences.en: All smiles in Strasbourg but uncertainty clouds Canada’s EU membership plan.
sentences.zh: 斯特拉斯堡的所有微笑，但不确定性掩盖了加拿大的欧盟成员国计划。

sentences.en: Although Mark Carney welcomed offer to become bloc’s first associate member, no one seems to know what that means Europe live – latest updates Mark Carney received a rapturous reception in the European parliament when he gave his speech on Thursday welcoming a proposal for Canada to become the EU’s first-ever associate member.
sentences.zh: 尽管马克·卡尼（ Mark Carney ）对成为欧盟第一个准成员的提议表示欢迎，但似乎没有人知道这意味着什么--最新消息马克·卡尼（ Mark Carney ）周四发表讲话，欢迎加拿大成为欧盟有史以来第一个准成员的提议，在欧洲议会受到热烈欢迎。

sentences.en: Politicians queued to shake his hand and take selfies.
sentences.zh: 政客们排队与他握手并自拍。

sentences.en: One described the speech as a historic moment.
sentences.zh: 一位发言者将这次演讲描述为一个历史性时刻。

sentences.en: “Europe has extended a hand, and Canada has taken it,” said the German Green MEP Terry Reintke, who borrowed a Canadian ice hockey shirt for the occasion.
sentences.zh: 德国绿党议员特里·莱因特克（ Terry Reintke ）借用了一件加拿大冰球衬衫，他说： “欧洲伸出了一只手，加拿大也伸出了一只手。”

items.title: Sweden’s PM resigns after centre-left bloc wins slim majority in election

sentences.en: Ulf Kristersson has stood down from his post, paving way for Social Democrats leader to form a government Sweden ’s centre-right prime minister, Ulf Kristersson, has stood down, clearing the way for Magdalena Andersson, the Social Democrats leader, to attempt to form a government.
sentences.zh: 乌尔夫·克里斯特森（ Ulf Kristersson ）已经下台，为社会民主党领导人组建政府铺平了道路。瑞典中右翼总理乌尔夫·克里斯特森（ Ulf Kristersson ）已经下台，为社会民主党领导人马格达莱娜·安德森（ Magdalena Andersson ）试图组建政府扫清了道路。

sentences.en: In a victory speech on Thursday, Andersson said the Swedish people had “voted for a new direction for our country, voted for unity and against division”.
sentences.zh: 安德森在周四的胜利演讲中表示，瑞典人民“投票支持我们国家的新方向，投票支持团结和反对分裂”。

sentences.en: Farming lobby says shoppers will see emptier shelves and higher prices because of restrictions on backpackers Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our new political email , free app or daily news podcast The farming lobby’s claim that immigration rule changes will increase food prices for households is wrong, Tony Burke has said, describing moves to speed up processing of backpacker visas as a positive step for agriculture.

items.title: Amid claims of ‘mass migration’, Labor hopes a measured approach will take the hot air out of the debate

sentences.zh: 内政部长的信息立即得到了雇主团体的支持，雇主团体最近几天明确表示，任意削减移民人数的举措将加剧本已严重的技能短缺，并损害企业，特别是该地区的企业。

items.title: Iran school bombing: grounds to believe US was behind atrocity, UN finds

sentences.en: Iran school bombing: grounds to believe US was behind atrocity, UN finds.
sentences.zh: 联合国发现，伊朗学校爆炸事件：有理由相信美国是暴行的幕后黑手。

sentences.en: Fact-finding mission says military strikes on school and sports facility in ⁠February constitute war ⁠crimes A UN fact-finding mission has determined there are reasonable grounds to believe the US was behind military strikes on a school and a sports facility in Iran in ⁠February that killed 120 children, and that these constituted war ⁠crimes.
sentences.zh: 实况调查团表示， 2月份对学校和体育设施的军事打击构成了战争罪行。联合国实况调查团已确定有合理的理由相信，美国是2月份对伊朗一所学校和一个体育设施的军事打击的幕后黑手，造成120名儿童死亡，这构成了战争罪行。

sentences.en: The school strike, which killed 156 civilians including 120 children, involved a US Tomahawk missile that collapsed the roof of the Shajareh Tayyebeh primary school, which the UN said was “clearly identifiable”, in Minab, Hormozgan province, on 28 February.
sentences.zh: 2月28日，一枚美国战斧导弹在霍尔木兹甘省米纳布的Shajareh Tayyebeh小学屋顶坍塌，造成156名平民死亡，其中包括120名儿童。联合国称该小学屋顶“清晰可辨”。

items.title: ‘Like a Disney movie’: Three wild dog brothers make Africa’s longest journey

sentences.en: ‘Like a Disney movie’: Three wild dog brothers make Africa’s longest journey.
sentences.zh: “像迪士尼电影一样” ：三只野狗兄弟踏上了非洲最长的旅程。

sentences.en: As three siblings came of age and had to leave their pack, scientists tracked the dogs’ perilous 2,500-mile odyssey to find their own territory It sounds like a Disney movie: three wild dogs, all brothers, on an epic journey to find a home of their own after their family tells them to leave.
sentences.zh: 随着三个兄弟姐妹长大成人，不得不离开他们的背包，科学家们追踪了这些狗的危险的2500英里奥德赛，找到了自己的领地。这听起来像是一部迪士尼电影：三只野狗，都是兄弟，在家人告诉他们离开后，他们踏上了一段史诗般的旅程，找到了自己的家。

sentences.en: They dodge cars and hunters in search of a new life, navigating bushmeat snares and the hostility of a human-dominated landscape until they find a new haven on the African savannah.
sentences.zh: 他们躲避汽车和猎人寻找新生活，引导丛林肉陷阱和人类主导景观的敌意，直到他们在非洲大草原上找到一个新的避风港。

sentences.en: But this is exactly what happened in Zambia last year, when three endangered African wild dogs made the longest-ever recorded single journey of any mammal from the continent.
sentences.zh: 但这正是去年在赞比亚发生的事情，当时三只濒临灭绝的非洲野狗进行了有史以来最长的单程旅行。

sentences.en: The brothers travelled more than 2,500 miles (4,100km) over eight months in their “dispersal” – when a young dog comes of age and must establish new territory to find a mate and start a family of their own.
sentences.zh: 兄弟俩在八个月的“分散”中旅行了超过2,500英里（ 4,100公里） –当一只年轻的狗成年时，必须建立新的领地来寻找配偶并建立自己的家庭。

items.title: Migrating the GitHub Copilot runtime to Rust, using Copilot

sentences.en: Migrating the GitHub Copilot runtime to Rust, using Copilot.
sentences.zh: 使用Copilot将GitHub Copilot运行时迁移到Rust。

sentences.en: The GitHub Copilot CLI , GitHub Copilot app , and GitHub Copilot SDK are all backed by the Copilot agent runtime, an agentic harness that can be embedded into applications and services.
sentences.zh: GitHub Copilot CLI、GitHub Copilot应用程序和GitHub Copilot SDK均由Copilot代理运行时提供支持， Copilot代理运行时是可嵌入到应用程序和服务中的代理线束。

sentences.en: It was originally written in TypeScript on Node.js and the V8 JavaScript engine for what is now the GitHub Copilot cloud agent (CCA), and the runtime stayed on that stack as the runtime and its capabilities grew rapidly.
sentences.zh: 它最初是用Node.js上的TypeScript和V8 JavaScript引擎编写的，现在是GitHub Copilot云代理(CCA) ，随着运行时及其功能的快速增长，运行时保留在该堆栈上。

sentences.en: That has now changed.
sentences.zh: 这已经成为过去。

sentences.en: Using the GitHub Copilot app and the Copilot CLI, we completely rewrote the runtime into more than 800,000 lines of production Rust.
sentences.zh: 使用GitHub Copilot应用程序和Copilot CLI ，我们将运行时完全重写为80多万行生产Rust。

sentences.en: AI agents wrote most of the code, spanning 128 pull requests that landed in main and shipped incrementally rather than waiting for a single cutover at the end.
sentences.zh: 人工智能代理编写了大部分代码，跨越了128个拉取请求，这些请求落在主服务器上并逐渐发货，而不是在最后等待一次切换。

sentences.en: The few inevitable regressions were discovered and fixed quickly along the way, while the performance of the runtime improved by orders of magnitude.
sentences.zh: 少数不可避免的回归被发现并迅速修复，而运行时的性能提高了几个数量级。

sentences.en: A project that would have taken a whole team of developers a year or two before agents was now completed primarily by a single developer, in only a few months, all while the rest of the team continued to greatly expand the runtime s capabilities and reach.
sentences.zh: 一个整个开发团队需要一两年时间才能完成的项目，现在主要由单个开发人员在短短几个月内完成，而团队的其他成员则继续大大扩展运行时的功能和覆盖范围。

sentences.en: Why we needed to port The Copilot agent runtime isn t just the engine behind the Copilot CLI.
sentences.zh: 为什么我们需要移植Copilot代理运行时不仅仅是Copilot CLI背后的引擎。

sentences.en: It backs a growing set of Microsoft, GitHub, and ecosystem solutions, for each of which AI support is, architecturally, a shell around the same runtime plus whatever customizations that solution needs.
sentences.zh: 它支持越来越多的Microsoft、GitHub和生态系统解决方案，对于每个解决方案， AI支持在架构上都是围绕同一运行时以及解决方案所需的任何自定义的外壳。

sentences.en: This includes not only the GitHub Copilot CLI and the GitHub Copilot app, but also the latest releases of VS Code, Visual Studio, CCA, Copilot Code Review ( CCR ), Copilot Cowork, Copilot Studio, and Excel and Outlook and PowerPoint and Word and it goes on.
sentences.zh: 这不仅包括GitHub Copilot CLI和GitHub Copilot应用程序，还包括VS Code、Visual Studio、CCA、Copilot Code Review (CCR)、Copilot Cowork、Copilot Studio、Excel和Outlook、PowerPoint和Word等最新版本。

sentences.en: These are very different products, and none of them wants to or should need to implement everything that goes into a production agent harness.
sentences.zh: 这些是非常不同的产品，它们都不希望或应该实施进入生产代理线束的所有内容。

items.title: When scanners miss the attack: how Cloudflare Client-Side Security protects storefronts

sentences.en: When scanners miss the attack: how Cloudflare Client-Side Security protects storefronts.

A modern storefront can look perfectly healthy while malicious JavaScript works underneath: siphoning affiliate revenue, hijacking searches and clicks, tampering with analytics, or asking a remote server what to execute next.
Pages load, products appear, and checkout works — yet the browser may be quietly doing something the site owner never authorized.
That is the blind spot our Client-Side Security machine learning (ML) model is built to expose.
This post follows four operations, spanning eight payloads, that our Page Shield ML uncovered in the wild.
The detection of these malicious payloads was automated; humans verified each finding only after the system had flagged it.
When we afterward reviewed the campaigns using security scanning tools, seven of the eight payloads were entirely absent from VirusTotal, and URLScan returned no malicious verdict for any of them.
Page Shield ML , meanwhile, caught all eight in live traffic.

For instance, while security research documented the broader Lnkr family years earlier, one specific payload version sat indexed by URLScan for nearly two and a half years with “No classification,” including during a direct scan in January 2024.
Only in this case had VirusTotal ingested the payload earlier: while it currently flags the script as malicious, public history does not reveal when that verdict was first assigned.
Meanwhile, Page Shield ML independently surfaced those exact bytes live on an online retailer's storefront.
More broadly, a hash can be known long before the code behind it is classified as malicious.

items.title: Kubernetes v1.37: Hardening Container Storage with Bind Mount Options and EmptyDir Permissions

sentences.en: Kubernetes v1.37: Hardening Container Storage with Bind Mount Options and EmptyDir Permissions.
Kubernetes v1.37 brings important storage security features: emptyDir permission modes and bind mount options.

They help application programmers and security professionals implement rigorous security policies, for example, prohibiting deletion of files across containers or execution of arbitrary binaries from writable volumes, directly in Kubernetes without any complicated circumvention.
Linux storage and permission fundamentals Before diving into the new Kubernetes features, let us briefly review the low-level Linux security mechanisms that make them possible.

Bind mount flags When Linux mounts or remounts a directory, Virtual File System (VFS) flags control what actions are permitted on that filesystem: noexec : Do not permit direct execution of any binaries on the mounted filesystem.
nosuid : Do not allow set-user-identifier or set-group-identifier bits to take effect.
nodev : Do not interpret character or block special devices on the file system.
Directory permissions and the sticky bit Standard Unix permissions regulate access across three scopes: Owner, Group, and Others (e.g., 0755 or 0777 ).
Beyond standard read, write, and execute bits, Linux supports the sticky bit (as in mode 01777 ).
When applied to a directory, the sticky bit ensures that a file inside that directory can only be deleted or renamed by the file's owner or root.
This is essential for shared writable directories like /tmp .
Motivation for the improvements Why does Kubernetes need bind mount options and emptyDir permissions?

items.title: AWS reimagines the getting started experience

sentences.en: AWS reimagines the getting started experience.
sentences.zh: AWS重新构想了入门体验。

sentences.en: Amazon Web Services (AWS) started with a handful of foundational infrastructure services such as Amazon Simple Storage Service (Amazon S3) , Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) , and Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) , so that anyone with an idea could start building.
sentences.zh: Amazon Web Services (AWS)始于一些基础基础架构服务，例如Amazon Simple Storage Service (Amazon S3)、Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2)和Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) ，因此任何有想法的人都可以开始构建。

sentences.en: As the world’s largest companies and governments adopted AWS, they asked for features to optimize their configuration for a range of global business contexts, security requirements, and operational needs.
sentences.zh: 随着全球最大的公司和政府采用AWS ，他们要求提供针对一系列全球业务环境、安全要求和运营需求优化配置的功能。

sentences.en: To meet these needs, AWS expanded globally through new Regions and added breadth and depth of services in security, networking, governance, and cost controls, so those customers could operate wherever they needed and at the scale they require.
sentences.zh: 为了满足这些需求， AWS通过新的区域进行了全球扩张，并在安全、网络、治理和成本控制方面增加了服务的广度和深度，因此这些客户可以随时随地以所需的规模运营。

sentences.en: That combination of global reach, breadth, and depth remains essential for those customers, but if you are at the start of a new idea, every configuration option is effort standing in the way of shipping your dream product fast.
sentences.zh: 这种全球影响力、广度和深度的结合对于这些客户来说仍然至关重要，但如果您正处于一个新想法的开始，那么每个配置选项都会阻碍您快速运送理想产品的努力。

sentences.en: Today, we’re announcing a new simplified experience on AWS for builders who are working at the pace of AI.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们宣布为正在以人工智能步伐工作的建设者提供AWS上的全新简化体验。

sentences.en: Instead of having to complete configuration tasks before you can work on your project, you start with sensible defaults and simple administration.
sentences.zh: 您无需在处理项目之前完成配置任务，而是从明智的默认设置和简单的管理开始。

sentences.en: You sign up using an existing identity from providers including Google, GitHub, and Apple.
sentences.zh: 您使用Google、GitHub和Apple等提供商的现有身份进行注册。

sentences.en: For most new customers, no credit card is required to start and you receive $100 in free credits as part of the AWS Free Tier .
sentences.zh: 对于大多数新客户，无需信用卡即可开始使用，您将获得$ 100的免费消费金作为AWS免费套餐的一部分。

sentences.en: You can build immediately in your first project.
sentences.zh: 您可以在第一个项目中立即构建。

sentences.en: As you continue to work, you can invite collaborators with just an email address, without learning about AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) or AWS IAM Identity Center .
sentences.zh: 当您继续工作时，您可以使用电子邮件地址邀请协作者，而无需了解AWS身份和访问管理(IAM)或AWS IAM身份中心。

sentences.en: When your project grows beyond the free credits, you can set a spend limit so you stay within your budget on the paid plan.
